cases.case_label: 3-kb retrotransposon insertion in FKTN (compound het with intron 5 variant)
cases.mechanism_detail: Infant with FCMD compound heterozygous for the 3-kb retrotransposon insertion in fukutin (class not named in the abstract; inferred SVA as the known FCMD founder insertion) and a deep intronic splice variant in intron 5; mechanism not studied.
cases.quote: FCMD was confirmed by genetic analysis, which revealed a 3-kb retrotransposon insertion in one allele of the fukutin gene and a deep intronic splicing variant in intron 5 in another allele
